maritimeGrouping: adjacent administrative units in the same original ADM0 constituent territory, with actual sea gap at most 100 km; distant dependencies excluded
notes: Parent sovereignty and passable terrain are inherited unchanged from modern-world v1. WGS84 geodesic land area, not projected pixels, determines splitting. ADM1 borders are retained; only oversized ADM1 units use pinned ADM2, and oversized Canadian ADM2 units use ADM3. Disconnected source administrative units remain intact; distant overseas components are never combined to manufacture the target area. Under/oversized results are explicitly reported, never silently relabelled. Raster coastline gaps are assigned to the nearest administrative geometry inside the same parent mask; no new straight or grid partition boundary is introduced. Climate is historical 1991-2020, not current weather. Ports are Natural Earth named real locations, not claimed complete or ranked by current throughput.
